What is a habit you are secretly proud of?
What is the funniest lie you told as a kid?

Which song do you sing when you are alone?
What is the silliest thing you are afraid of?

What is the best gift you have ever received?

Which bad movie do you secretly love?
What is your most used emoji and why?
What is something you have never told your parents?

string-array.name: game_friends_dare
string-array.item: Do an impression of someone at the table until they guess who it is.
Talk in a robot voice until your next turn.
Sing the chorus of the last song you listened to.
Tell your best joke. If nobody laughs, tell another one.
Give everyone here a nickname.
Describe your day so far like a sports commentator.
Act out a movie scene without words until someone guesses it.
Say the alphabet backwards as fast as you can.
Give a one-minute speech about why socks are important.
Show your best dance move for ten seconds.
Speak only in questions until your next turn.
Compliment the person on your right in three different ways.
Make up a short rap about the person who asked.
Do your best evil villain laugh.
Pretend to be a tour guide and present this room.
Keep a straight face for 30 seconds while everyone tries to make you laugh.

string-array.name: game_best_truth
string-array.item: What is your favourite memory of us?
When did you feel closest to me?
What is one thing I do that annoys you a little?
What did you think of me the first time we met?
What is the secret you have kept the longest?
What do you wish you had told me earlier?
When did you last cry, and why?
What is your biggest worry about the future?
What is the best decision you have ever made?
Which of my habits would you steal?
What from years ago are you still proud of?

What is one thing you want to change about yourself?
What is the kindest thing someone has done for you?
What is a dream you have not told anyone?

Which compliment have you remembered for years?

string-array.name: game_best_dare
string-array.item: Tell the story of how we met like a film trailer.
Do an impression of me.
Say three things you love about the person who asked.
Recreate a funny photo of us using only your face.
Sing a made-up song about our friendship.
Describe me in exactly five words.
Share an old inside joke and explain it to the others.
Give a short thank-you speech for the “best friend of the year” award.
Act out the last time we laughed really hard.
Name your favourite moment with each person here.
Plan our next adventure together in one minute.
Talk about our week like a news reporter.
Draw a quick portrait of the person on your left, on paper or in the air.
Tell everyone one thing they don’t know about you.
Let the group pick a word you must use in every sentence until your next turn.
Write a three-line poem about the person who asked and read it aloud.

string-array.name: game_couples_dare
string-array.item: Look your partner in the eyes and give a sincere compliment.
Hold hands until your next turn.
Describe our perfect date in one minute.
Write a two-line love poem and read it aloud.
Do an impression of how your partner laughs.
Tell the story of our first date as a fairy tale.
Give your partner a 30-second shoulder massage.
Say three reasons you are grateful for your partner.
Slow dance together for 20 seconds, even without music.
Plan our next weekend out loud.
Hum a song that reminds you of your partner until they guess it.
Give your partner a sweet new nickname.
Act out the moment we first met.
Whisper something kind to your partner.
Draw a heart on your partner’s hand with your finger.
Promise your partner one small thing for tomorrow.
